summary: Tested Pluxee campaign dashboard bug fix. All 9 backend tests passed. Verified: (1) Pluxee Ramadan KPIs return non-zero values (distributed, inscriptions, activeUsers, transactions all > 0), (2) Pluxee Ete returns different data (data isolation), (3) Sofrecom (non-Pluxee) regression check passed, (4) Pluxee user sees only their campaign in dropdown, (5) Admin Pluxee endpoints work (campaigns, users list, user creation), (6) Sub-stores page loads for both admin and Pluxee users. UI testing confirmed Pluxee user login shows only their campaign 'Pluxee - Campagne Ramadan 2025' in dropdown.
seed_data_creation: Test data was seeded using PluxeeTestDataSeeder.php - 3 Pluxee campaigns, 3 test users, 45 clients (15 per campaign), subscriptions, and transaction history
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pluxee campaign dashboard fix verified. The alternate query methods (getPluxee*) work correctly without carte_recharge_client. Dashboard API response takes ~33s for Pluxee campaigns. Pluxee users are restricted to their assigned campaign via pluxee_campaign_access field in users table.
